name: A Level Has One Name (buttons, missions, achievements, store)
note: Written with the gate on 2026-09-28 (BACKLOG ES-1, LV-1). Each mutation puts back one of the real mismatches the gate was built from.

mutations.name: the Spanish buttons go back one step off
mutations.why: Lv.1 is called Fácil on the home screen and Principiante in the daily mission; every level after it shifts too, so a Spanish player reads Lv.2 as Medium.

mutations.name: the Korean mission names a level the app does not have
mutations.why: The daily mission asks for 「Lv.1 매우 쉬움」 — a very-easy level no button offers — while the button says 입문.

mutations.name: a German achievement calls Lv.5 by the old name
mutations.why: The achievement asks for Lv.5 Meister; the Lv.5 button says Experte. A player hunting for a Meister level finds none.
mutations.find: 'Lv.5 Experte mit 0 Fehlern und 0 Tipps lösen'
mutations.replace: 'Lv.5 Meister mit 0 Fehlern und 0 Tipps lösen'

mutations.name: the Spanish store listing names the old levels
mutations.why: The listing promises Fácil to Maestro with an Experto the app does not have, and no Principiante; the store and the app describe different ladders.
mutations.find: - Principiante, Fácil, Medio, Difícil y Maestro.
mutations.replace: - Fácil, Medio, Difícil, Experto y Maestro.
mutations.expectFailure: no line names the five levels

mutations.name: a Portuguese achievement calls Lv.5 by the old name, behind the Nv. prefix
mutations.why: Portuguese writes Nv., not Lv. — the first version of this gate never read it, and "Nv.5 Mestre" sat under a button saying Especialista. Since 2026-09-30 the app writes Lv. here; the mutation puts back the old prefix with the old name, so the name check must still read behind Nv.
mutations.find: desc: 'Conclua o Lv.5 Especialista com 0 erros e 0 dicas'
mutations.replace: desc: 'Conclua o Nv.5 Mestre com 0 erros e 0 dicas'

mutations.name: the Arabic mission names a very-easy level the app does not have
mutations.why: Arabic writes مستوى, not Lv. — the mission asked for "مستوى 1 سهل جداً" (very easy) while the button says مبتدئ. Since 2026-09-30 the app writes Lv. here; the mutation puts back the old prefix with the old name.
mutations.replace: beginnerLv1Title: '[مستوى 1 سهل جداً] حل لغز سودوكو 1'

mutations.name: Russian writes the game header level as Ур. again
mutations.why: User decision 2026-09-30: Lv. in every language. The home buttons said Lv.3 while the game header said Ур.3 — one level, two marks between the button and the board.

mutations.name: the Arabic share text writes the level as مستوى again
mutations.why: The first sweep changed three files per language and missed this one; the new check found it on its first run.
